covers.description: The criterion ids this test proves, such as ["AC-1", "AC-3"]. Use the same ids you sent in criteria. A criterion no test names is reported as having no tests.
covers.title: Covers

expected.description: What must be true afterwards, worded so it can only be true or false. "The page shows: Locked for 30 minutes" — not "it works".
expected.title: Expected

id.description: Your id for this test, such as "TC-04".
id.title: Id

kind.description: What kind of test this is. "normal" is the path that works; "wrong input" is bad data or no permission; "at the limit" uses the exact boundary value; "unusual" is everything rarer.
kind.title: Kind

steps.description: What the tester does, one action per step. At least one.
steps.title: Steps

test_data.description: The exact values this test uses: the amount, the file size, the number of tries. Say "$50.00", not "an order over the limit".
test_data.title: Test Data

title.description: What this test proves, in one line.
title.title: Title
